newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume boosted by arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume boosted by arbitrage.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose to 1,335 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 839 kilos as banks engaged in arbitrage deals, dealers said.
Gold closed at $349.00 an ounce, unchanged from Thursday's close, but rose in lira terms to 1,472,000 lira per gram from 1,466,400 as the Turkish currency eased against the dollar.
"One can say that there was almost no demand from the free market today. Almost all the day's trade was due to the banks conducting arbitrage," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira fell to 131,040 lira to the dollar from Wednesday's close of 130,750 lira.
Of the day's volume, 310 kilos of gold was traded in the morning session and 1,025 kilos in the afternoon, 58.8 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
